title: Community: Study Group Shenanigans
description: A study group at the world’s most chaotic community college.

questions.question: What is the name of the community college where the show takes place?
At Greendale Community College, what subject does Jeff pretend to need help with to get closer to Britta?
In Spanish class at Greendale, what TV trope does Abed reference constantly?
Abed's meta humor peaks during what annual Greendale battle simulation?
questions.hint: Modern Warfare and A Fistful of Paintballs

questions.question: Paintball wars aside, Greendale's mascot is a faceless, generic figure called the what?
questions.hint: Designed to offend no one by being nobody
questions.explanation: Dean Pelton picked a mascot so inoffensive it has no race, gender, or face—just a white bodysuit.
